name: io.github.kcofoni/duplicati-mcp
description: MCP server for Duplicati backup management — list, run, monitor and configure jobs from an LLM.

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICATI_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Duplicati instance (e.g. http://localhost:8200)

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICATI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Duplicati web interface password (leave empty if none configured)

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICATI_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable write operations (run, abort, update, import). Default: false

environmentVariables.name: DUPLICATI_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to Duplicati-server.sqlite — enables SQLite history tools (db_*). Leave empty to disable.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.author: kcofoni
features: List all configured Duplicati backup jobs
Monitor live backup progress and server status
Export, update and import backup job configurations
SQLite-backed history: operation logs, errors, restore points, metadata (opt-in)
